stem: Which monitoring practice gives the strongest basis for detecting a meaningful source-water change over time?
choices: Sample mainly when plants show visible stress, using those events to establish whether the source-water chemistry has changed
Use a consistent sampling point and method, record pH and EC with verified instruments, and compare results with the established trend
Change the sampling location at each reading so the monitoring program captures as much facility variation as possible
Record the final nutrient solution rather than the source water because fertilizer addition removes the need to trend the incoming source
rationale: Trend interpretation is strongest when measurements are collected consistently with verified instruments. Consistent source-water records help distinguish real changes from sampling or measurement variation.
